arguments.command:
FIX_CSV=$(ls /opt/nothingness/media/*.opus | sort | paste -sd, -); echo "$FIX_CSV" | head -c 100; export DRIVE_TARGET=linux; export DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="nothingness_linux_debug"; export DRIVE_RUN_LOG="/tmp/flutter_run_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}.log"; export DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO="/tmp/flutter_input_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"; export DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME="/tmp/nothingness_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"; python - <<'PY'
import os,subprocess, json, textwrap, sys
fix_csv=os.environ['FIX_CSV']
# helper to run drive.py
DRIVE=os.path.join('.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py')
base_env=os.environ.copy()

def run(args):
    p=subprocess.run(['python3',DRIVE,*args],env=base_env,capture_output=True,text=True)
    if p.returncode!=0:
        print('STDERR',p.stderr)
        print('STDOUT',p.stdout)
        raise SystemExit(p.returncode)
    return p.stdout

# 1 screen void
out=run(['screen','void'])
print('screen void:',out)
# 2 setQueue once with startIndex 0
out=run(['call','ext.nothingness.setQueue',f'paths={fix_csv}', 'startIndex=0'])
print('setQueue:',out)
# 3 pause
out=run(['pause'])
print('pause:',out)
# 4 open settings and enable shuffle via tap
out=run(['settings','open'])
print('settings open:',out)
# tap shuffle toggle
out=run(['tap','void-settings-status-shuffle'])
print('tap shuffle:',out)
# close settings
out=run(['settings','close'])
print('settings close:',out)
# 5 resume (play)
out=run(['resume'])
print('resume:',out)
# 6 get playback state
out=run(['call','ext.nothingness.getPlaybackState'])
print('playback after resume:',out)
data=json.loads(out)
# find songInfo path
song=data.get('songInfo') or {}
path=song.get('path')
print('current path',path)
# 7 next
out=run(['next'])
print('next:',out)
out=run(['call','ext.nothingness.getPlaybackState'])
print('playback after next:',out)
data2=json.loads(out)
song2=data2.get('songInfo') or {}
path2=song2.get('path')
print('next path',path2)
# verify within set
paths=set([p.strip() for p in fix_csv.split(',')])
print('shuffle flag',data.get('shuffle'),data2.get('shuffle'))
print('within set before',path in paths,'after',path2 in paths)
assert data.get('shuffle') is True, 'shuffle not enabled'
assert path in paths and path2 in paths and path!=path2
print('OK')
PY
